channel.title: The Escape Plan: Nigeria travel alerts
channel.description: Travel advisory changes and entry-rule updates for Nigeria.

item.title: Official entry info for Nigeria was updated (Nov 10, 2026)
item.description: UK government note: "This travel advice has been reviewed for accuracy with changes made throughout, including on land borders, street and vehicle crime, withdrawing and exchanging money, financial scams, terrorism in Nigeria, kidnapping for ransom, transport risks, dangers at road checkpoints, taxis and buses, sea travel, swimming safety, North West Nigeria and South East and South South Nigeria (See ‘Entry requirements’, ‘Safety and security’ and ‘Regional risks’ pages)." Updates like this can affect other passports too, so check the official entry rules for your passport before you book or travel. From The Escape Plan travel data. General information, not legal advice. Always check the official source before you travel.
